description: Defines the MojoCdmService class implementing a ContentDecryptionModule for media decryption, including initialization, session management, and interaction with ContentDecryptionModule components.

classes.name: MojoCdmService
classes.description: Implements a ContentDecryptionModule backed by media::ContentDecryptionModule, managing initialization, sessions, and communication with media components.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the MojoCdmService with a CdmFactory and configuration, creating the real CDM.

methods.name: SetClient
methods.description: Sets the client remote for communication.

methods.name: CreateSessionAndGenerateRequest
methods.description: Creates a new session and generates a request.

methods.name: UpdateSession
methods.description: Updates a session with response data.

methods.name: GetCdm
methods.description: Returns the ContentDecryptionModule used by the service.
